mod.minecolonies_spore.name: Minecolonies x Spore Integration
mod.minecolonies_spore.desc: Enables Minecolonies guards to proactively detect and attack Fungal Infection: Spore mobs.
message.minecolonies_spore.cured_by_doct: %s was cured from Mycelium infection by the colony Doctor using Ice!
message.minecolonies_spore.cured_by_play: %s was cured from Mycelium infection with Ice!
com.minecolonies.research.combat.spore_d: Spore Warfare I
Train colony forces in anti-fungal combat and sealants (+25% Damage & +25% Defense against Spore mobs)
Spore Slayer II
Advanced strikes severing mutant tendrils and biomass (+50% Damage against Spore mobs)
Spore Slayer III
Tactical incendiary combat doctrine (+75% Damage against Spore mobs)
Spore Slayer IV
Master exterminators capable of dismantling hive abominations (+100% Damage against Spore mobs)
Apex Spore Slayer V
Supreme anti-fungal devastating lethality (+125% Damage against Spore mobs)
com.minecolonies.research.effects.spore_: Increases damage dealt by all colony citizens and guards against Fungal Infection: Spore entities by +25% to +125%.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.spore_d: Spore Resistance I
Reinforce leather and shields with organic sealants (+25% Defense against Spore)
Spore Resistance II
Layered metallurgical plating absorbing heavy kinetic impacts (+50% Defense against Spore)
Spore Resistance III
Cryogenic treated armor repelling fungal tendril penetration (+75% Defense against Spore)
Spore Resistance IV
High-density reinforced carapace minimizing bludgeoning trauma (+100% Defense against Spore)
Apex Spore Resistance V
Impenetrable bio-tempered Netherite barrier against all fungal hostility (+125% Defense against Spore)
com.minecolonies.research.effects.spore_: Increases citizen defense, reducing damage taken from Spore mobs by +25% to +125%.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.spore_i: Synthesize advanced anti-fungal antibodies. All citizens become 100% immune to Mycelium infection.
com.minecolonies.research.effects.myceli: Grants complete 100% immunity to Mycelium infection for all citizens in the colony.
